declared: 2026-10-30, WP-11 Phase H4, before any profile run
description: Opt-in runtime profiles of the cutting_research_v1 policy env (open_cutting_env(..., preset='cutting_research_v1', runtime_profile=...), scripts/collect_dataset.py --runtime-profile). Without runtime_profile nothing changes. Only full_physics_v1 can produce acceptance-valid episodes; every research_fast_v1 episode is labelled acceptance_valid=false.

full_physics_v1.purpose: Formal resolution for acceptance: the scene-declared solver at 1 mm particles and a 4 mm grid, 0.1 ms material dt, 20 ms control; cameras and recording as declared by the preset and the caller.
full_physics_v1.note: native.stage_reset=reload_in_place is the WP-11 Phase H1 reset (no Kit open_stage after the first reset); its reset repeatability is in docs/reports/WP11_PHASE_H_PROFILING.md. Camera rate, global camera and recording rate are not reduced by this profile.

research_fast_v1.purpose: Cheaper settings for policy iteration only: the WP-11 F3 'coarse' numerics (2 mm particles, 8 mm grid, 0.2 ms material dt), wrist cameras only at 10 Hz and reduced recording.

fidelity_limits.source: docs/reports/WP11_PHASE_F_LAW8.md, F3 resolution study (coarse = 2 mm, 8 mm, 0.2 ms; formal = 1 mm, 4 mm, 0.1 ms)
fidelity_limits.trim_removal: TRIM-02-K2-R10 removal 0.816 (coarse) vs 0.956 (formal); the removal >= 0.9 criterion FAILS at this resolution
fidelity_limits.cut_location: CUT-03-K2 interface location 3.0 mm (coarse; its ideal-partition floor is 3.0 mm) vs 1.5 mm formal; the frozen 2 mm location bound cannot pass at this resolution
fidelity_limits.contact_forces: Contact forces are not resolution- or dt-converged (F3: halving dt raises the CUT mean force 2.6x; coarse CUT mean force 0.001 N vs 0.012 N formal); do not use research_fast forces quantitatively
fidelity_limits.cameras: global D455 omitted and policy frames refreshed every 5 control steps (10 Hz); recorded frames every 25 steps (2 Hz)
fidelity_limits.scope: Policy iteration and pipeline debugging only; never an acceptance, benchmark or calibration result
